description: First RRST 2.0 unit (Teensy 4.0 + TMC2209), bench-tested in Aarhus

anchors.provisionalReason: Measured with an uncut, longer-than-production tube. The zero does not depend on tube length; the full-scale point probably does. Re-measure full scale with the production tube.
anchors.zeroCriterion: wedge first touches the tube, as seated in a real session. A gap behind the tube (round cutouts vs flat backstop, about 0.5 mm) persists past touch, so 'tube flat against backstop' is not usable
anchors.method: bench/anchorSession.m, wedge closed in 0.25-1 mm steps, one person at the device; log in bench/sessions/anchors__device_2E4441D76D5F2996__2026-10-28.log

observations.endOfTravel: at 41196 (0.06 mm from max) air still passes with maximum effort; the tube never fully closes
observations.tubeEffectSteps: about +1150 with the tube in; elastic, no lost steps (bench/slipTest.m)
observations.moveTimes: 0.25 mm 0.40 s, 0.5 mm 0.56 s, 1 mm 0.80 s, 3 mm 2.07 s, full travel 4.09 s (command to 'Move complete.')
